takeoffDefinition: First control observation with zero wheel contacts, upward velocity, and CG at least 1 mm above its initial height; observation precision is 20 ms.

eventDefinitions.rollPhaseEntry: First control observation whose command is in flip phase. This is a state-machine event, not evidence of nonzero commanded or realized roll.
eventDefinitions.firstNonzeroRollCommand: First flip command with abs(requested nozzle body-X torque)>10 Nm and positive roll-rate reference; timestamp and state are the pre-command observation.
eventDefinitions.firstRealizedRollTorque: First actual frame with abs(body-X moment of the 12 recorded nozzle forces)>10 Nm; excludes fan/contact moments.
eventDefinitions.firstRollMotion: First actual frame with abs(body-X angular velocity)>0.05 rad/s.
eventDefinitions.firstRollCommand: Deprecated alias for rollPhaseEntry. Do not label this as physical roll onset.

historyNotice: Events are extracted from revision-specific raw recordings. Four older gate-only baselines without saved frames are replayed once using archived r5 source and cached separately, never with the 15-parameter r6 controller. Command and motion onset are sampled at 20 ms, not exact substep times.
